text: widget reports state inputs named output id. output called "cal": input$cal_selected always Date vector, Date(0) — NULL, list() — user selected nothing. means obvious code works without guards: Selections sent event priority, clicking date twice, re-picking date just cleared, reaches server times rather swallowed unchanged value.

what: A date picker instead of a calendar
title: VanillaCalendar in Shiny
text: Forms usually want date field, permanent block calendar. inputMode: widget renders text box, opens calendar popup box clicked, writes chosen date . input$when_selected updates usual. Use height = "auto" input mode, positionToInput ("auto", "bottom", "top", "left", "right", pair c("bottom", "left")) say popup goes.
code: VanillaCalendarOutput("when", height = "auto")  output$when <- renderVanillaCalendar(   VanillaCalendar(list(inputMode = TRUE, selectionDatesMode = "single"),                   height = "auto") )

what: Changing a calendar without re-rendering it
title: VanillaCalendar in Shiny
text: Re-running renderVanillaCalendar() builds whole new calendar: selection lost, displayed month jumps back, widget visibly flickers. change something calendar already page, use proxy. verbs map onto library’s instance methods: reset says thrown away change applied — year, month, dates, time, locale: Inside Shiny module, build proxy unnamespaced id; uses session work full one:
code: observeEvent(input$theme, {   vcSet(VanillaCalendarProxy("cal"), list(selectedTheme = input$theme)) }) proxy <- VanillaCalendarProxy("cal")  vcSet(proxy, list(dateMin = input$start))   # apply new options vcUpdate(proxy)                             # re-render with current options vcShow(proxy)                               # show a popup calendar vcHide(proxy)                               # hide it again vcDestroy(proxy)                            # remove it entirely # clear the selection as well as changing the options vcSet(proxy, list(selectedDates = list()), reset = list(dates = TRUE)) calendarServer <- function(id) {   moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {     output$cal <- renderVanillaCalendar(VanillaCalendar())     observeEvent(input$go, vcHide(VanillaCalendarProxy("cal")))   }) }

title: VanillaCalendar in Shiny
text: two pieces together — options R, applied proxy — give common “end date start date” behaviour without re-rendering:
code: server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$start <- renderVanillaCalendar(     VanillaCalendar(list(inputMode = TRUE), height = "auto")   )   output$end <- renderVanillaCalendar(     VanillaCalendar(list(inputMode = TRUE), height = "auto")   )    observeEvent(input$start_selected, {     vcSet(VanillaCalendarProxy("end"), list(dateMin = input$start_selected))   }) }

title: Shiny bindings for VanillaCalendar — VanillaCalendar-shiny
code: # Only run examples in interactive R sessions if (interactive()) {   library(shiny)   library(VanillaCalendar)    ui <- fluidPage(     VanillaCalendarOutput("calendar"),     verbatimTextOutput("dates")   )    server <- function(input, output) {     output$calendar <- renderVanillaCalendar({       VanillaCalendar(         options = list(           type = "default",           locale = "en",           selectionDatesMode = "multiple"         )       )     })     output$dates <- renderPrint(input$calendar_selected)   }    shinyApp(ui, server) }

title: Update a calendar in place from Shiny — VanillaCalendarProxy
text: VanillaCalendarProxy() creates handle calendar already rendered, can changed without re-rendering — calendar keeps position, focus selection instead flickering back initial state. methods map onto Calendar instance methods Vanilla Calendar Pro. vcSet() applies new options calendar. vcUpdate() re-renders calendar current options. vcShow() vcHide() show hide popup calendar input mode. vcDestroy() removes calendar page.

title: Update a calendar in place from Shiny — VanillaCalendarProxy
text: proxy object, invisibly, calls can piped.

title: Update a calendar in place from Shiny — VanillaCalendarProxy
code: if (interactive()) {   library(shiny)   library(VanillaCalendar)    ui <- fluidPage(     selectInput("theme", "Theme", c("light", "dark")),     actionButton("clear", "Clear selection"),     VanillaCalendarOutput("cal")   )    server <- function(input, output, session) {     output$cal <- renderVanillaCalendar(       VanillaCalendar(list(selectionDatesMode = "multiple"))     )      observeEvent(input$theme, {       vcSet(VanillaCalendarProxy("cal"), list(selectedTheme = input$theme))     })      observeEvent(input$clear, {       vcSet(VanillaCalendarProxy("cal"), list(selectedDates = list()),             reset = list(dates = TRUE))     })   }    shinyApp(ui, server) }

title: VanillaCalendar 2.0.0
text: Upgrade Vanilla Calendar Pro 3.2.0, whose options flat rather nested. breaking change.

title: VanillaCalendar 2.0.0
text: bundled library moves 2.9.3 3.2.0. Options longer nested settings: settings$lang now locale, settings$selection$day now selectionDatesMode, settings$visibility$theme now selectedTheme. See upstream reference. Unknown option names now raise warning instead silently ignored. input$<id>_selected now Date vector rather character vector, Date(0) rather list() nothing selected. input$<id>_selected_month now 1-12 rather JavaScript 0-11. input$<id>_selected_arrow renamed input$<id>_displayed Date (first day displayed month) rather unpadded string. VanillaCalendarOutput() defaults width = "100%" rather "1000px".

title: VanillaCalendar 2.0.0
text: VanillaCalendarProxy() vcSet(), vcUpdate(), vcShow(), vcHide() vcDestroy() change rendered calendar place Shiny server, without re-rendering . inputMode = TRUE renders text input popup calendar. New Shiny inputs: input$<id>_time (time selection), input$<id>_week (week number clicks) input$<id>_ready (calendar initialised). Date POSIXct values options converted "YYYY-MM-DD" strings library expects, options must JSON arrays boxed, selectedDates = Sys.Date() works. options defaults list(), VanillaCalendar() renders calendar. Callbacks supplied htmlwidgets::JS() now run addition built-Shiny handlers rather replacing .

title: VanillaCalendar 2.0.0
text: Clicking date outside Shiny (RStudio viewer, R Markdown) longer throws Shiny defined. Re-rendering calendar destroys previous instance instead leaving stale event handlers behind. Repeated identical selections sent Shiny event priority, longer swallowed deduplication.
